## Change and reason

What changed, why is it needed, and is there a simpler alternative?

## Evidence and uncertainty

Which checks or observations support the change? What remains unproved?
Examples and proposed checks are not executed results.

## Delegation and review

Did the work stay within the established boundary? Surface consequential changes
and decisions needed. Existing mandatory review and platform controls still apply.
Neither a passing whitespace check nor this report grants approval or authority.
